acceptance_criteria: The supplied Stage 1 ledger is hash-bound and records COMPLETE with manager and independent PASS_RUNTIME_READY verdicts before Stage 2 proceeds.
HEAD before scoped task edits is exactly 4da200886c73252c5271f5bf89de61c5c32ba062.
Only the approved LH-MODEL-01 identity manifest, founder identity approval, front bust, and rear-profile corroboration are authority; every bound hash must verify.
The rejected casting board never supplies garment, product, construction, scene, or provider model-image authority.

Zero-spend reconciliation proves no prior Stage 2 candidate, execution receipt, approval receipt, or paid-attempt marker exists and compares the current authenticated credit balance to Stage 1 without POST /v1/run.
Current first-party pricing proves the exact request costs no more than four credits: one 1k fast output at one credit plus one face-reference surcharge of three credits.
The preflight returns PASS_PENDING_APPROVAL for the exact unmodified contract and reports one execution fingerprint, one candidate, four credits, sufficient live balance, and reserved output paths.

Before POST /v1/run, the founder receives the exact fingerprint, contract and source hashes, full request parameters, exact live price, candidate ceiling, output/receipt paths, attempt-marker semantics, no-retry rule, and unknown-outcome recovery rule.
No paid request occurs until the founder explicitly approves that exact fingerprint for one candidate at a maximum of four credits in this task.
If approved, exactly one non-idempotent Model Create submission is made; the attempt marker is consumed before submission and no retry is made for any result or ambiguous outcome.

Any candidate remains quarantined and candidate-only until an independent reviewer passes every contract identity, anatomy, framing, plain-garment, background, and product-absence check against the exact candidate hash.
The exact independently reviewed full-body plate receives a separate explicit founder approval before any approved identity path or authority receipt is created.
VTO, promotion, scene wiring, storefront wiring, publication, and deployment do not begin in Stage 2.
